002 MEET THE TEAM

Building orbital power at scale

Mitchell Fogelson, PhD

Co-Founder & CEO

PhD from Carnegie Mellon University. Industry and academic experience in both robotics and aerospace applications with expertise in design of mechanical meta-materials and mechanisms.

Pele Collins

Co-Founder & CTO

7 years at SpaceX leading the Dragon parachute systems team. Deep expertise in deployment mechanisms, reliability engineering, and human-rated space hardware.

Charles Gai

Founding Engineer

PhD from the University of Cambridge. Previously an engineer at SpaceX on the Launch Tower and Solar Array teams. Deep expertise in deployable structures and origami-inspired mechanisms.

Brandon Edelson

Head of Engineering

Previously Lead Propulsion Engineer at SpaceX, where he spent nearly 11 years developing propulsion systems for both Dragon and Starship. BS in Aerospace Engineering from USC.

Brian Jackson

Founding Software Engineer

PhD in nonlinear optimization and trajectory planning from Carnegie Mellon. Previously Senior Optimization Engineer at Albedo and Robotics Software Engineer at NVIDIA, building hardware-accelerated motion planning libraries for autonomous systems.

Britney Lee

Mechanical Engineer

Mechanical engineer with a BS from Stanford and an MA in Design Products from the Royal College of Art. Developed hardware and materials for climate solutions at Oxford University and the Stanford Precourt Institute for Energy, and led design and manufacturing programs on Apple's desktop team and at hardware startups like BrewBird.

Evan Burger

Mechanical Engineer

6 years at Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory as a Senior Space Instrument Mechanical Engineer. Led the design, build, and test of instruments that fly on NASA and U.S. government space missions, from concept through flight qualification and delivery.

Slava Koblov

Mechanical Engineer

Former Mechanical Engineer at Saronic. Graduated with a Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering degree from Cornell.

Ana Reyes

Workplace Experience Manager

Startup operations leader with 10+ years of experience building systems, processes, and infrastructure for growing organizations.

Alejandro McNab-Segarra

Manufacturing Operations Lead

Former Founder and Owner of Shape to Form, a precision CNC Machining company acquired by Beyond Reach Labs. CNC Programmer, Machinist, and Manufacturing Engineer with 15 years of experience in precision manufacturing.
